angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 471,685 km at 107.45 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.3064 +/- 0.0164 mas (same row, RUWE 1.08): 107.45 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.678 +/- 0.052 solar radii from Duck et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-212 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..136D/abstract): 471,685 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.622 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Duck et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-212 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..136D/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4349 +/- 50 K from Duck et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-212 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..136D/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Duck et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-212 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..136D/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-212.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.569, rounded to two decimals

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
